gaql: SELECT click_view.gclid, campaign.id, campaign.name, ad_group.id, metrics.clicks, segments.date FROM click_view
notes: Google ClickView requires a single-day segments.date.
gclid is an Ads click_view field — not a GA4 dimension.
Ads last-click / click rows are not sole truth vs GA4 DDA Ads-id recipes.
